muc.title: A dozen programs every day
muc.text: A scientist jumps between a dozen programs, databases and papers every day. Claude Science brings them all into one place.

muc.title: Not a new model
muc.text: It's not a new model. It's a desktop app, now in beta: Claude plus a lab's toolkit.

muc.title: Connected to 60+ databases
muc.text: It connects to more than sixty scientific databases, runs data analysis, and shows proteins or molecules you can rotate and explore.

muc.title: Checks itself, and can be redone
muc.text: As it works, it checks for wrong citations and images without clear sources. Every step is recorded, so others can redo it and get the same result.

muc.title: From data to paper
muc.text: From raw data to charts to a paper draft, it's all in one place.

muc.title: Who can use it?
muc.text: Claude Science is for Pro plans and up, and free for eligible scientists at universities or nonprofits.

muc.title: Claude, tailored for each job
muc.text: For the rest of us, the thing to remember is: Claude is getting versions tailored to specific jobs.

muc.title: A science paper in plain words
muc.text: If you're a student or researcher, ask your school whether you can use it for free. If not, send Claude the abstract of a science paper and ask it to explain in plain words, with sources.

muc.title: All 9 tools
muc.text: That's all nine tools in the Claude toolbox. Pick one and try it today.
